name: What types of paint finishes are best for different rooms?

mainEntity.name: What types of paint finishes are best for different rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint finish depends on the room's function and desired durability. For high-traffic areas like hallways, kitchens, or bathrooms, semi-gloss or satin finishes are recommended due to their increased durability and ease of cleaning. Eggshell or satin finishes are popular for living rooms and bedrooms, offering a subtle sheen that is more forgiving than flat paint. Flat or matte finishes are ideal for low-traffic areas or ceilings, as they conceal imperfections well but are less washable. City Dweller, LLC can advise on the optimal finish for each room based on usage and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-gloss/satin works best for high-traffic areas; eggshell/satin for living spaces; flat/matte for low-traffic rooms and ceilings. Choose based on room function.
